material.acceptance_criteria: Join click from a second isolated page leaves peers at 0 (local) only if no peer is announced; with a host in the room the count rises to 1.
material.description: The join click reproduces verbatim on the one available page: after fill room name lobby and click join, #status reads room lobby / peers 0 (local) / joined (dispatch 1792850143224-2889-eb5442728253749a). A second profile is not reachable through gm: all session names share one target (dispatch 1792850542980-3155-2146d659c9ba31e4), and the browser lease is one per project root. Clearing action: the same isolated-page primitive named in peer-join-connecting-no-peer-blocker-drain-l-1.
material.resolution: isolated=true gives the second profile; blocker cleared.
material.subject: gm browser verbs cannot give a second Chrome profile, so the join-click witness for peer-join-no-effect-separate-profile cannot run as a two-profile test
material.witness: Second isolated page (targetId D03587C5CF9077CA5CD9EFF82B557B4F, separate browserContextId) reads room lobby / peers 4 (net) with a host in the room. The join click witness is 1792893633597-6198-a9ab6d6e67b8692e. Acceptance met.
material.witness_plan: Join click on the second isolated page, then read #status and the room list after 15 s.
